name: fangorn-index
description: Three skills. fangorn-index: discover the apps registered on Fangorn and read their corpora — rank every publisher against a question without downloading any of them, search the one that wins, hand off to the app that owns it, carrying a taste kernel that lives on the filesystem. westmarch-app: build one — records to graph, schema, commit, westmarch-view, page, agent card, on-chain binding. fangorn-improve: improve a live app one gated pull request at a time — work its observations, close coverage gaps, lift its weakest goal — never publishing, deploying or merging.
